data.name: Sharvikaaran
data.long_meaning: Sharvikaaran is a combination of two words: Sharva and Kaaran. Sharva refers to Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and creation. Kaaran means cause or reason. Therefore, Sharvikaaran is a name for the god of wealth and prosperity, who is believed to be the cause of all creation.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvikaaran represents the divine energy that brings prosperity and abundance into one's life. It is a reminder of the power and wisdom of Lord Shiva, who is the ultimate creator and sustainer of the universe.

in_sanskrit.name: शर्विकारण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects or is the husband of Goddess Sharvi. Goddess Sharvi is a form of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: शर्विकारण
in_hindi.meaning: शर्वि का पति या स्वामी, संपर्कवत
in_hindi.long_meaning: शर्वि का पति या स्वामी (Sharvi's husband or master) या संपर्कवत (or the protector).

in_tamil.name: ஷர்விகாரண்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷர்வியின் மக்கள் (Sharvi's husband) அல்லவாய் (or Sharvi's protector).

in_telugu.name: షర్వికారణ

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, Sharvikaaran is considered a significant deity, especially among the Shaivite sects. He is often depicted as a mighty, powerful figure holding a Trishula (a three-pronged staff) and a Damaru (a small hand drum). Devotees believe that by invoking the blessings of Sharvikaaran, they can attract wealth, prosperity, and success in their endeavors.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Sharvikaaran" lies in its association with Lord Shiva as the ultimate creator and cause of all things. By focusing on the name, Hindu devotees aim to remember Shiva as the giver of blessings and the source of all abundance. The name "Sharvikaaran" offers an reminder that the ultimate cause of all wealth, prosperity, and success comes from within, and the divine power of the gods, represented by Shiva, is the true source of all that we seek.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sharvikaaran is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. The name Sharvikaaran carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Sharvikaaran is a charioteer of Arjuna, one of the Pandava brothers.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names.
